note: Architecture dimensions transcribed field-by-field from each model's own config.json (the `source` URL on every entry), never from survey articles — surveys report parameter counts reliably and dims only sporadically. `totalParameters` is the safetensors parameter total read from the Hugging Face model API unless the entry's note says otherwise (the frontier MoEs ship FP8/MXFP4 checkpoints whose packed totals exceed the published parameter count, so those rows carry the published figure and explain the gap). `headDim` is the config's explicit `head_dim` where present, else `hidden_size / num_attention_heads`; it is frequently NOT `hidden / heads`, so q/o projections are non-square on most 2026 models and adapter sizing must use `heads x headDim`. For MoE entries `ffnDim` is the per-expert `moe_intermediate_size` — except gpt-oss, whose config has no such field and whose `intermediate_size` 2880 IS the per-expert width — and `activeParameters` is the published per-token activated count, recomputed from the config where the config permits it: compute follows active, memory follows total, and conflating them overstates FLOPs 20-34x. `dimsVerified: false` marks models whose dims are faithfully recorded but whose per-layer shape is not a uniform GQA + SwiGLU stack, so the engine should use its fallback dims there rather than applying the exact adapter formula. Three distinct reasons put a row in that bucket in 2026: latent attention (deepseek-v3, kimi-k2, mistral-small-4-119b, glm-5.2 — no plain k/v projections exist to adapt); hybrid stacks where most layers are linear/gated-delta attention holding no KV cache at all (qwen3.8-27b at 48 of 64 layers, qwen3-next-80b-a3b at 36 of 48); and DeepSeek-V4's compressed sparse attention (deepseek-v4-flash), which has no kv_lora_rank and a per-layer compression ratio array, and so is recorded as mqa on its config's own head counts rather than as mla. Deliberately excluded for size: Kimi K3 (2.8T total / 104B active, 69 KDA + 24 gated-MLA layers, 896 experts — https://huggingface.co/moonshotai/Kimi-K3/raw/main/config.json), DeepSeek-V4-Pro (1.6T/49B) and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (552B backbone plus 196B engram, causal encoder-decoder); all three are beyond any practical fine-tuning budget and none is describable by this schema. Qwen3.5-27B is architecturally identical to qwen3.8-27b (same dims, same 27,781,427,952 total) and GLM-5.3 is an FP8 release of glm-5.2's architecture (same dims, same 753,329,940,480 checkpoint total), so neither is listed separately.

models.label: Llama 3 8B
models.note: LoRA calibration standard: r=16 on all 7 linear projections gives exactly 41,943,040 trainable parameters, matching PEFT's reported figure. meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B is gated (HTTP 401); dims read from the NousResearch mirror.

models.label: Llama 3.1 8B
models.note: Identical dims to Llama 3 8B apart from the 128K context. meta-llama repo is gated (HTTP 401); dims read from the NousResearch mirror.

models.label: Llama 3.1 70B
models.note: meta-llama repo is gated (HTTP 401); dims read from the NousResearch mirror.

models.label: Llama 3.1 405B
models.note: meta-llama repo is gated (HTTP 401); dims read from the hugging-quants NF4 mirror, whose text config is unmodified. Parameter total from the meta-llama safetensors index.

models.label: Qwen 2.5 7B
models.note: NVIDIA NeMo LoRA benchmark model — the fine-tuning MFU defaults are back-solved from its published throughputs.

models.label: Qwen 2.5 32B
models.note: NVIDIA NeMo LoRA benchmark model.

models.label: Qwen 2.5 72B
models.note: NVIDIA NeMo LoRA benchmark model. Licensed under the Qwen License, not Apache-2.0 (the HF repo tags it `other`).

models.label: Qwen3 8B
models.note: Plain Qwen3 dense GQA stack: no sliding window (use_sliding_window false), explicit head_dim 128 so heads x headDim = 4096 is square against hidden. The uniform formula reproduces the 8,190,735,360 safetensors total to under 0.1%.

models.label: Qwen3 32B
models.note: heads x headDim = 8192 against hidden 5120, so q/o are non-square and adapter sizing must use heads x headDim. 8:1 GQA ratio, the widest in the Qwen3 dense line.

models.label: Mistral Small 3 24B
models.note: hidden 5120 but heads x headDim = 4096, so the q/o projections are not square — adapter sizing must use heads x headDim, not 2 x hidden.

models.label: Gemma 2 9B
models.note: google/gemma-2-9b is gated (HTTP 401); dims read from the unsloth mirror. Embeddings are tied, and the 256K vocab is 10% of all parameters. heads x headDim = 4096 exceeds hidden 3584, so q/o are non-square. Alternating sliding (4096) / full attention layers do not change the parameter count.

models.label: Gemma 2 27B
models.note: google/gemma-2-27b is gated (HTTP 401); dims read from the unsloth mirror. Embeddings are tied; heads x headDim = 4096 is below hidden 4608, so q/o are non-square.

models.label: Phi-4 14B
models.note: Phi3ForCausalLM fuses qkv into one gate_up/qkv projection in the checkpoint; the logical per-projection dims above are what adapters are applied to.

models.label: gpt-oss 20B-A3.6B
models.note: Same block shape as gpt-oss 120B at 24 layers and 32 experts. activeParameters recomputed from the config as 3.605B, matching the published 3.6B. The smallest MoE in this catalog and the one that fits a single 80 GB GPU for LoRA; note the MXFP4-native checkpoint means a BF16 fine-tune upcasts the experts.

models.label: gpt-oss 120B-A5B
models.note: OpenAI's open-weight MoE. ffnDim is the config's intermediate_size 2880, which here is the per-expert width (there is no separate moe_intermediate_size); heads x headDim = 4096 exceeds hidden 2880, so q/o are non-square. activeParameters recomputed from the config as input embeddings + 36 x (attention + 4 experts) = 5.118B, matching the published 5.1B. Layers alternate sliding_attention (window 128) and full_attention with identical dims, so the parameter count is unaffected. Shipped natively in MXFP4 for the expert weights (attention, router and embeddings stay BF16), which is why the safetensors total splits 2.17B BF16 / 114.66B U8.

models.label: Gemma 4 31B
models.note: Dims above are the sliding-attention layers (50 of 60). The 10 full-attention layers use global_head_dim 512 with 4 KV heads, so adapter and KV-cache figures carry a few percent of error. Parameter total includes the vision tower.

models.label: Mixtral 8x7B
models.note: The classic MoE reference. activeParameters recomputed from the config as embeddings + 32 x (attention + 2 experts) = 12.88B, matching the published ~12.9B. Do not 4-bit QLoRA an MoE: bitsandbytes lacks native MoE support and quantization interferes with expert routing.

models.label: Qwen3 235B-A22B
models.note: ffnDim is moe_intermediate_size 1536; every layer is sparse (decoder_sparse_step 1, mlp_only_layers empty), so the dense intermediate_size 12288 is unused. activeParameters recomputed from the config as 22.19B, matching the published 22B.

models.label: Qwen3-Next 80B-A3B
models.note: Extreme sparsity: 10 of 512 experts per token at moe_intermediate_size 512, plus a shared expert of the same width, for 3B active out of 80B resident — a 27x total-to-active ratio. Hybrid stack: full_attention_interval 4 means only 12 of 48 layers are full attention (the dims above describe those); the other 36 are gated-delta linear attention (linear_num_key_heads 16, linear_num_value_heads 32, head dim 128) and hold no KV cache. dimsVerified is false for that reason. activeParameters is the published 3B figure; the 2 KV heads at headDim 256 over 12 layers make this the lightest KV footprint of any model here at its size.

models.label: Llama 4 Scout 109B-A17B
models.note: meta-llama repo is gated (HTTP 401); dims read from the unsloth mirror of the Instruct variant. Every layer is MoE and also carries a shared expert of width intermediate_size_mlp 16384 that the uniform formula omits, which is why the implied total runs ~6% under the measured one. Parameter total includes the vision tower.

models.label: Gemma 4 26B-A4B
models.note: ffnDim is moe_intermediate_size 704; the dense intermediate_size 2112 is the shared expert. Dims above are the sliding-attention layers (25 of 30); the 5 global layers use global_head_dim 512 with 2 KV heads. Parameter total includes the vision tower, hence 25.8B against the 25.2B text-only figure.

models.label: DeepSeek-V3 671B-A37B
models.note: MLA, not GQA: there are no k/v projections to adapt, and the KV cache stores a latent of kvLoraRank 512 + qkRopeHeadDim 64 = 576 per token rather than kvHeads x headDim = 16384 — a 28x smaller footprint. dimsVerified is false because the exact 7-projection adapter formula does not describe this attention block. Layers 0-2 are dense (intermediate_size 18432); layers 3-60 are sparse with 256 routed experts plus 1 shared expert of the same width. totalParameters is the published 671B; the released checkpoint reads 684.5B because it bundles an extra multi-token-prediction layer and FP8 scale tensors.

models.label: DeepSeek-V4-Flash 284B-A13B
models.note: DeepSeek-V4 replaces V3 MLA with a hybrid of Compressed Sparse Attention and Heavily Compressed Attention: there is no kv_lora_rank at all, num_key_value_heads is 1 at head_dim 512, and a per-layer compress_ratios array alternates 4x and 128x compression, so the attentionType is recorded as mqa on the config's own head counts rather than as mla. dimsVerified is false: neither the 7-projection adapter formula nor the plain 2 x L x H_kv x d_head KV formula applies. DeepSeek reports the V4 series needs 27% of the single-token FLOPs and 10% of the KV cache of V3.2 at 1M context. totalParameters and activeParameters are the published 284B / 13B.

models.label: Mistral Small 4 119B-A6B
models.note: MLA attention, so dimsVerified is false for the same reason as DeepSeek-V3: no plain k/v projections exist. KV latent is 256 + 64 = 320 per token. Every layer is sparse (first_k_dense_replace 0) with 128 routed experts plus 1 shared expert of width 2048.

models.label: GLM-5.2 744B-A40B
models.note: MLA plus a sparse-attention indexer (index_n_heads 32, index_head_dim 128, index_topk 2048), so neither the adapter nor the attention-memory formula applies as written. headDim records qk_head_dim 256, which equals v_head_dim; the config's own head_dim field is qk_nope_head_dim 192. Layers 0-2 dense (intermediate_size 12288), 3-77 sparse. totalParameters is the published 744B; the released checkpoint reads 753.3B because it bundles a multi-token-prediction layer.

models.label: GLM-4.6 357B-A32B
models.note: The GQA generation of GLM, before GLM-5.x moved to MLA — so unlike glm-5.2 the exact adapter formula applies here. heads x headDim = 12288 against hidden 5120, strongly non-square. Layers 0-2 are dense (intermediate_size 12288) and 3-91 sparse with 160 routed experts plus 1 shared expert of width 1536, which the uniform formula omits; the implied total lands 1.3% over the 356.79B safetensors figure. activeParameters recomputed from the config as 32.78B, matching the published A32B.

models.label: Qwen3.8 27B
models.note: Hybrid stack: only 16 of 64 layers are full attention; the other 48 are gated-delta linear attention with their own head geometry (linear_num_key_heads 16, linear_num_value_heads 48, head dim 128) and no KV cache at all. The dims above describe the 16 full-attention layers. dimsVerified is false because both the adapter count and the KV/activation footprint would be substantially wrong if the uniform formula were applied. Parameter total includes the vision tower and the MTP layer.

models.label: Kimi K2 1T-A32B
models.note: MLA with DeepSeek-V3 latent dimensions (the config declares DeepseekV3ForCausalLM) but 384 routed experts instead of 256 and 64 query heads instead of 128, so the KV latent is the same 512 + 64 = 576 per token while the model is 1.5x larger. dimsVerified is false because latent attention has no plain k/v projections to adapt. Layer 0 is dense (intermediate_size 18432); layers 1-60 are sparse with 384 routed plus 1 shared expert of width 2048. totalParameters and activeParameters are the published 1T / 32B; the released checkpoint reads 1,026.4B because it is stored in FP8 with per-block scale tensors.
